screens.title: privacy
screens.heading: Privacy
screens.says: Everything is off unless you turn it on. I'll tell you what each one means.

fields.label: Diagnostics
fields.help: Counts of which Bunny features are used. No file names, no text you type. Sent to ComradeArt. Optional; off by default.

fields.label: Crash reports
fields.help: A stack trace when something crashes, plus the OS version. Can contain a file path. Sent to ComradeArt when you approve each one. Optional; off by default.

fields.label: Feedback
fields.help: Only what you write and choose to send. Nothing is collected in the background.

fields.label: Location services
fields.help: Approximate location from nearby Wi-Fi names. Used by apps that ask, one at a time. Never leaves this computer unless an app you allowed sends it.

fields.label: Microphone available to apps
fields.help: Off means no app can record, including Bunny. You can still allow one app later.

fields.label: Camera available to apps
fields.help: Off means no app can see the camera. You can still allow one app later.

fields.label: Online AI providers
fields.help: Sends what you ask Bunny to a provider you choose and pay for. Off means Bunny works only with what is on this computer. Set up later, never during install.

fields.label: Remote processing
fields.help: Lets a task run on another machine you own. Off by default.

screens.announcement: Privacy. Everything is off unless you turn it on. I'll tell you what each one means. Eight settings, every one off: diagnostics, crash reports, feedback, location services, microphone available to apps, camera available to apps, online ai providers, remote processing. Each says what data is involved and where it goes.
